files.description: Single-page PDF documenting EHI export file formats. Lists CCD/C-CDA, JSON, and PDF for single patient exports (USCDI v1 scoped), and MSSQL .bak database backup for patient population exports. No data dictionary, schema, or field-level documentation included.

Full HTML of the ONC certification page for EchoVantage. Contains the EHI Export section with descriptions of single patient and population export modes, plus links to the file formats PDF, FHIR API documentation, and real world testing.
